titulo: Your 128 GB phone doesn't have 128 GB 📱
descripcion: Part of it goes to the operating system, part to how computers count gigabytes. Here's where your storage really goes.

escenas.texto: You bought a phone with one hundred twenty eight gigabytes. Then you open settings, and a big chunk is already gone.
First thief: the operating system. iOS or Android, plus the apps that come preinstalled, can take ten to twenty gigabytes before you install anything.
Second thief: math. Phone makers count a gigabyte as one billion bytes. Your phone counts it as about seven percent more.
So one hundred twenty eight real gigabytes show up as about one hundred nineteen.
Third thief: you. Photos, chats, and app caches grow every single day. Messaging apps alone can quietly eat gigabytes.
Quick fix: open your storage settings, sort by size, and clear the biggest app caches first. Follow for more phone secrets.
